title: norm을 보존하는 분광 방향 보정
hypothesis: C2MS keeps its remaining spectral angle error in the high-frequency detail and in low-norm pixels that the MSE objective underweights; a head that only rotates each output pixel's band vector (norm kept) and is trained with MSE + lambda x per-pixel angle can lower SAM without lowering PSNR, because at a fixed norm the per-pixel squared error decreases monotonically with the angle.
control: C2MS (53 QB, 54 GF2/WV3) best.pt of the same seed, unchanged

reference_rr_means.source: 53/54 results/evaluation_v2_3.json models.<key>.RR (archived evaluation); phase 0 must reproduce them within 1e-3 dB / 1e-3 deg

phase0.data: PanCollection RR test, all 20 scenes per target, GT available; FR is not used (no GT)
phase0.precision: C2MS inference FP32 on CPU, metrics in float64 DN with common/metrics.rr_metrics
phase0.lowpass: per-band sensor MS MTF blur at full resolution (54 prepare.SENSORS GNyq, 41 taps, replicate border), no decimation

diagnostics.D1_norm_deciles: pixel angle (deg) vs GT norm deciles per scene: mean angle and share of the SAM sum per decile
diagnostics.D2_pan_gradient: pixel angle vs PAN Sobel gradient magnitude terciles (flat / middle / edge) per scene
diagnostics.D3_ndvi: pixel angle by GT NDVI class: water/shadow < 0, 0-0.3 bare/urban, >= 0.3 vegetation (band index red/nir per sensor)
diagnostics.D4_frequency_swap: SAM after replacing only the low band of the prediction with the GT low band (LF fixed) and only the high band (HF fixed)
diagnostics.D5_lms: SAM of the given LMS (23-tap upsampled MS) for reference
diagnostics.D6_mse_weight: correlation between the per-pixel MSE weight n*|g| and the per-pixel angle (MSE underweights low-norm pixels)

gates.rule: fixed before measurement; evaluated on QB, mean of seeds 42-44 against the same-seed C2MS; other targets are reported without a gate

Ga_local_direction_oracle.construction: per non-overlapping 8x8 window, least squares B x (B+1) affine band map from prediction to GT fitted on one checkerboard half of the window and applied to the other half (cross-fitted, so a pixel never sees its own GT); output keeps the prediction norm: y' = |y| * normalize(A y + b)
Ga_local_direction_oracle.meaning: headroom that a local spectral direction correction can reach in principle (an oracle that uses GT, not a model)

Gb_direction_ceiling.construction: y' = |y| * GT direction (norm of C2MS, exact GT direction; SAM = 0)
Gb_direction_ceiling.meaning: how much of the C2MS squared error is due to direction alone

gates.decision: both pass -> phase 1 (frozen C2MS + direction head). Either fails -> report phase 0 only and revise the design; no training

phase1_plan.status: not started; runs only after phase 0 gates pass and user approval

arms.H1: frozen C2MS + direction head, MSE only (capacity control)
arms.H2: frozen C2MS + direction head, MSE + lambda x angle (main candidate)
arms.H3: frozen C2MS + free residual head y + delta, MSE + lambda x angle (norm-preservation control)

phase1_plan.head: about 32 channels, 4 conv layers, <= 50k parameters; inputs: current direction u = y/|y|, LMS direction, upsampled observation residual Up(MS - D(y)), PAN high band; output delta projected on the tangent plane of u, y' = |y| * normalize(u + delta_perp); last conv zero-initialized so y' = y at start
phase1_plan.loss: MSE(y', g) + lambda x mean atan2(|y' perpendicular to g|, y' . g_hat) on the original and the 2x coarser pairs (scale mixing kept)
phase1_plan.selection: lambda and epoch by validation: minimum validation SAM among epochs whose validation PSNR >= same-seed C2MS validation PSNR - 0.02 dB; test is never used for selection
phase1_plan.screen: QB seed 42 for H1-H3, then H2 (validation-chosen lambda) on QB/GF2/WV3 seeds 42-44 and WV2 transfer, H1 on QB seeds 42-44
phase1_plan.phase2_condition: QB 3-seed mean dSAM <= -0.10 deg and dPSNR >= -0.02 dB in phase 1 -> end-to-end C2MS + head from scratch with scale mixing

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3, unchanged, against the same-seed C2MS
judgement.sam_goal: reported separately and fixed now: QB 3-seed mean dSAM <= -0.15 deg (first goal, 4.43 deg level) / <= -0.28 deg (stretch) with dPSNR >= -0.04 dB; RR2, FR_WALD, observation ratio and WV2 transfer reported with it
judgement.note: a large SAM decrease with an RR PSNR gain below the 0.04 dB noise threshold is labelled 부분 개선 by v2.3; the SAM goal row does not change that label

limits: phase 0 uses the RR test set that earlier experiments already used repeatedly for exploration; oracles use GT and are ceilings, not achievable models
constraints: no training in phase 0; archived checkpoints are read only; writes only below results/
